mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (line_user_id, display_name, created_at) VALUES (#{lineUserId}, #{displayName}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET display_name = #{displayName}, display_name_customized = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, line_user_id, display_name, display_name_customized, created_at FROM users WHERE line_user_id = #{lineUserId}
SELECT id, line_user_id, display_name, display_name_customized, created_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, line_user_id, display_name, display_name_customized, created_at FROM users
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM users WHERE line_user_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND created_at < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM family_members m WHERE m.user_id = users.id)
